obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Hero canvas, full-bleed media stages, feature-tile backgrounds, and dark product controls

graphite.$description: Graphite — Raised navigation and near-black control surfaces

carbon.$description: Carbon — Charcoal content bands, comparison panels, and dark text on white sections

steel.$description: Steel — Hairline card borders, translucent control fills, and dark chrome

slate.$description: Slate — Input outlines, secondary dividers, and subdued interface text

ash.$description: Ash — Muted explanatory copy, inactive labels, and subdued metadata

porcelain.$description: Porcelain — Primary text on dark surfaces and pale alternate section backgrounds

white.$description: White — High-contrast dark-surface text, bright comparison cards, and icon details

apple-blue.$description: Apple Blue — Filled Buy and Learn More controls — a concentrated blue punctuates the otherwise monochrome purchase path

electric-link.$description: Electric Link — Links on black and charcoal surfaces, including inline learning paths and section navigation

cobalt-link.$description: Cobalt Link — Links on pale surfaces and footer-like utility contexts

copper-new.$description: Copper New — Small New labels and release-status annotations

optical-yellow.$description: Optical Yellow — Technical camera-spec emphasis within product storytelling

sf-pro-text.$description: Navigation, purchase controls, links, body copy, product labels, legal markers, input text, and compact feature explanations. The compact negative tracking keeps dense interface language visually quiet beside large hardware imagery.

sf-pro-display.$description: Section labels, product names, feature metrics, and exhibition-scale headlines. At 80px and 96px, -1.2px and -1.44px tracking compress the heavy 600 weight into a single sculptural block rather than a loud promotional banner.
